trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلٰى مَا وَهَبْتَ لِيْ مِنِ انْطِوَاۗءِ مَا طَوَيْتَ مِنْ شَهْرِيْ وَاَنَّكَ لَمْ تُحِنْ فِيْهِ اَجَلِيْ وَلَمْ تَقْطَعْ عُمُرِيْ وَلَمْ تُبْلِنِيْ بِمَرَضٍ يَضْطَرُّنِيْ اِلٰى تَرْكِ الصِّيَامِ وَلَا بِسَفَرٍ يَحِلُّ لِيْ فِيْهِ الْاِفْطَارُ فَاَنَا اَصُوْمُهٗ فِيْ كِفَايَتِكَ وَ وَقَايَتِكَ اُطِيْعُ اَمْرَكَ وَاَقْتَاتُ رِزْقَكَ وَاَرْجُوْ وَاُؤَمِّلُ تَجَاوُزَكَ فَاَتْمِمِ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDO A’LAA MAA WA HABTA LEE MENIN TEWAA-E MAA TA-WAIY-TA MIN SHAHREE WA ANNA-KA LAM TOHIN FEEHE AJALEE WA LAM TAQTA’ O’MO-REE WA LAM TUBLE-NEE BE-MARA-ZIN YAZTAR-RONEE ILAA TARKIS SEYAA-ME WA LAA BE-SAFARIN YA-HILLO LEE FEEHIL IFTAARO FA-ANAA ASOOMO-HU FEE KEFAA-YATE-KA WA WAQAA-YATE-KA OTEE-O’ AMRA-KA WA AQTAA-TO RIZQA-KA WA ARJOO WA O-AMME-LO TAJAAWO-ZAKA FA-AT-MEME.

trans.en: O my God! Praise belongs to You for the portion of the moon that has passed from this month that You have granted me, and have not let my life end and have not yet taken my life, and have not made me so ill as to have to stop fasting, and have not made me travel so that I have to break the fast. I fast under Your Sufficiency and Protection during it, obey You, eat Your Sustenance, and hope for Your Pardon.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ عَلَيَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ نِعْمَتَكَ وَاَجْزِلْ بِهٖ مِنَّتَكَ وَاسْلَخْهُ عَنِّيْ بِكَمَالِ الصِّيَامِ وَتَمْحِيْصِ الْآثَامِ وَبَلِّغْنِيْ آخِرَهٗ بِخَاتِمَةِ خَيْرٍ وَّخَيْرَهٗ يَا اَجْوَدَ الْمَسْئُوْلِيْنَ وَيَا اَسْمَحَ الْوَاهِبِيْنَ وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA A’LAIYYA FEE ZAALE-KA NE’MATA-KA WA AJZIL BEHI MIN-NATA-KA WAS-LAKH-HO A’NNEE BE-KAMAA-LIS SEYAAME WA TAMHI-SIL ASAA-ME WA BALLIGH-NEE AAKHE-RAHU BE-KHAATE-MATE KHAIRIN WA KHAIRA-HU YAA AJ-WADAL MASOO-LEENA WA YAA ASMA-HAL WAAHE-BEENA WA SALLAL LAAHO A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE-HIT TAAHE-REENA.

trans.en: O my God! Please perfect Your Blessings for me and increase my share by Your Favor. And let it end with the completion of fasting and the elimination of sins, and let me reach its end and benefit from its good termination and its benefits. O the Most Benevolent of those asked, and the Most Bestowing of those who bestow. And may God bestow blessings on the Prophet Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s) the pure.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
